issues: Remove the incorrect fanfare summon ability; Magic Sediment's text does not have a Fanfare and token cards should not summon themselves on entry.
Remove the incorrect passive damageCap ability; Stack does not mean this amulet takes only 1 damage per hit.

Remove the incorrect passive grantIndestructible ability; Stack means 'when this card would leave the field, remove 1 Stack counter instead' and 'when its Stack count reaches 0, destroy it,' not indestructible.

The activated ability should target another amulet with Stack on your field, not any ally field card; encode a target restriction for another allied Stack amulet. If the engine cannot target allied amulets by Stack trait/counter, implement a target selector or filter for allied field amulets with Stack.

The spell is incorrectly encoded as a free choose between normal mode and Earth Rite mode. Encode it as deal 2 damage by default, with an Earth Rite (2) conditional replacing that with deal 4 damage and draw 1 card.

The start-of-end condition is wrong; it should check whether there is another Chess follower on your field, not whether Magical Bishop is on your field. Encode a condition for another allied Chess follower. If unavailable, implement a condition such as fieldTraitMin with excludeSelf or an equivalent 'another allied follower with trait' check.

The damage effect is wrong; it should deal 1 damage to each enemy leader, not to each enemy follower and leader. Encode damage to enemy leaders only. If multiplayer 'each enemy leader' is unsupported, implement an effect for dealing damage to all opposing leaders.

Encode an allied field-entry trigger limited to your turn for Mount cards. If unavailable, implement a timing/condition for 'when a card with trait X is put onto your field' and a 'your turn only' restriction.
